contexts.text: Besides many other ornaments, which are varied and succeed one another.
The Ancient Church is here described by many ornaments.
Vessels of ornament of gold and silver () = the Knowledges of good and truth. AE 725:10.
I ornamented thee with an ornament (). Explained.
The various clothes and ornaments of the daughters of Zion, which are here enumerated. () = all the genera and species of good and truth.
Truth and good and their ornaments. Signified, Illustrated.
The spiritual and celestial things of the Celestial Church are signified by these ornaments -ornatus ().

To clothe himself with scarlet, and ornament himself with an ornament of gold () = to teach truths of doctrine from a celestial origin, and the goods of life; consequently, truths and goods from the Word.
See Ornament. AE 827:5.

No one put on himself an ornament () = the quality of their external in that it was devoid of the Divine. Ornament = the Divine in externals... The reason this is signified by ornament, is that ornament has reference to garments, by which, in general, are signified Divine truths.
By their ornaments here enumerated. () are signified the truths and goods of the Church...
(Thus) by ornament in general, is signified the Divine truth of the Church. Further illustrated.
To put an Ornaments of gold upon the garment () = to cause truths to be beautiful from good.
Ornaments, in the opposite sense, = truths falsified. Illustrated.
Their rooms were ornamented with such decorations that...
They saw ornaments of unspeakable beauty...
They represented conjugial love in its life, and in its adornment: in its life, in their faces; and in its adornment in their garments.
(The application of the woman is to such things) as serve for adornment, both to decorate herself, and to exalt her beauty.
His chamber then appears adorned with various things.
The ornament with which he was ornamented () = in general, all truths from good, and the derivative intelligence.
Occurs.
That the Church is now adorned with truths from good to receive. Signified, Explained.
